expectations.statement: This dataset holds fixtures and nothing else. There is no ground_truth.json, no verdict, no rationale and no expected value of any kind anywhere in this directory, and none may be added by a model. The rows below were selected by the author from the shape each fixture was written to probe; no matcher was run to choose them, and no matcher output was consulted while writing them. Expected verdicts, if this dataset ever acquires any, must be written by a human reviewer reading the documents.

authors: assistant:claude-opus-5 — fixture author only. Authored the profiles, the postings and the row selection. Authored no expectation, and is not eligible to.
review.why: docs/matching-v6-declared-only-analysis.md §G lists the evidence still required before any V6 declared-only policy could be defended. declared_only_v1 covers none of items 2-6. Each pairing below exists for one of them.

pairings.probes: Exposure wording on both sides at once: the posting lowers its bar with the same words the profile uses to hedge its claim, and two of the posting's lines put an exposure word next to a production ask.
The same hedged prose claims against a posting that sets a bare bar and a duration bar instead of an exposure one.
A technology asserted twice in declaring fields while the project's own description says it was not used. §G item 4: is a second declaration evidence, or the same claim repeated?
§G item 5: technologies a project description says were used, declared in no structured field at all.
§G item 6: a stated duration the profile's own dates contradict, a stated duration nothing corroborates, and a stated duration the employment record agrees with, against two duration bars.
The same stated durations against exposure-worded asks rather than duration bars, plus one ask for a technology the profile never names.
The control for the exposure axis: exposure-worded asks meeting evidence that is not in doubt, and one bare declaration in the same profile for contrast.
